notes.title: Roots Devour Ready for Steam Next Fest – New Demo Update Live!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! We are Rewinding Games, the developers of the Lovecraftian indie game Roots Devour. We’re excited to announce that Roots Devour is officially joining the February Steam Next Fest! The demo is now available for download on Steam, with the latest update v0.1.1.0 released simultaneously. Come and experience the latest version!

[h2]v0.1.1.0 Update Highlights[/h2]
[h3]Inspiration System:[/h3]
[*]A new Inspiration System has been added! Players can unlock knowledge about inspiration gain at the [b]Ritual Place[/b], such as: “Gain 20% Inspiration whenever you open a card pack.”
[*]When the Inspiration bar is full, you will receive a gift from the Mother, allowing you to choose certain cards to add to your deck.

[h3]Card Expansion & Balancing:[/h3]
[*]New Card: [b]Ancient Scroll[/b] – When played, it grants 50% Inspiration instantly, but it may also shuffle Evil into your deck.
[*]Adjusted effects for most played cards. Introducing new card decks: [b]Seed[/b], [b]Flower[/b], [b]Mutation[/b], and [b]Evil[/b]. Each deck represents a unique playstyle—use them to aid your exploration of the forest.

[h3]Enhanced Exploration Experience:[/h3]
[*]Paths traversed by the Root will now become [b]Corrupted[/b]. When the roots regenerate, these paths may undergo mutations. On Corrupted paths, Root will now act autonomously, allowing players to skip previously explored areas.
[*]While exploring the forest, you may discover [b]Hearts of the Tree[/b], granting permanent attribute bonuses.
[*]Some hidden Easter eggs have been quietly scattered throughout the ever-changing forest.

The full version of Roots Devour is currently in development, and the demo content does not represent the final quality of the game. If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please use the "Feedback" and "Bug Report" options in the main menu to share your thoughts with us!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2612690/_/

notes.title: Roots Devour Demo FAQ
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751741/72f36ca7c0136fa04e642a3b4234c0ba8426aa1f.jpg[/img]
[h2][Roots Devour Discord Now Open][/h2]
Recently, we finally had some time to set up our Discord. What I mean is, everything is now on track and can be precisely measured.
Joined our Discord: https://discord.gg/mrpB3zqwRq
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751741/1e4b29444d60cedb6a0dc7aa40a5ef30b22944ec.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751741/edd48eca355a2f58c2e6907ae1a34225b5f556a0.jpg[/img]
[h2][Player Q&A][/h2]
In the past year, we’ve completed a brand-new card design and the framework for most of the levels.
Honestly, the first day of work was filled with hope and excitement—it was even livelier than the New Year! During the Spring Festival holiday, we didn’t rest either. We went through every piece of player feedback we could find and carefully recorded everyone’s suggestions! At the same time, we discussions about frequently raised issues, all aimed at bringing a better experience to you.

For the most frequent feedback, here are our answers:

[h3]-About the Frame Rate[/h3]
The current demo version has technical limitations. As the card count increases later in the game, it may consume a significant amount of GPU memory. We’re actively working on resolving this and will implement a comprehensive optimization in the full version!
[h3]-About Brightness[/h3]
We’ve noticed that some players find the game’s visuals a bit too bright. To provide a more comfortable visual experience, we’ve decided to include a gamma adjustment feature in the full version, allowing players to adjust the brightness according to their preferences and screen settings.
[h3]-About Camera Control[/h3]
Thanks for the feedback! We’re working on optimizing camera settings and minimap operations to make controls smoother and exploration easier!
[h3]-About Localization[/h3]
We’ve noticed some translation issues in the English version and sincerely apologize for that! We plan to fix those errors in the full version to provide a more accurate and fluid experience. Thank you for your understanding and support!
[h3]-Chapter Content[/h3]
The story of Chapter 1 takes place on the edge of human territory. In Chapter 2, set in a swampy map, players will face off with human conflicts and, for the first time, reveal your identity as a ruler, secretly influencing the course of the world. The forest is just the beginning—the world will gradually unfold in the future story.

Lastly, a big thanks to you all! And happy new year!

notes.title: Roots Devour's demo harbours the seeds of a brilliant horror card RPG

So to settle my nerves, I got up and played a game about being a horrible tree. Just the worst tree. A total shit of a tree. That game was Roots Devour - and great news, if you’re having trouble sleeping you can play it too, for there is a demo in the wilds.

notes.title: 《Roots Devour》Demo 1.0.3 Version Update
notes.content:
[h2]BUG Fixes[/h2]

- Fixed an issue where connecting stone cracks would cause the game to freeze.
- Fixed an issue with the [Cat] card being incorrect.
- Fixed an issue with the unlocking of Talents.
- Fixed an issue where the [Owl] would speak randomly when placed.
- Fixed an issue where the path above would be relocked after completing the game.
- Fixed an issue where items in the shop could not be clicked for purchase.
- Fixed an issue where follower cards would disappear unexpectedly.
- Fixed an issue where the [Owl] would fly back to the hand when returning to the forest, even if it was killed.

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]

- Optimized rendering performance by adjusting lighting rendering to reduce GPU consumption.
- Optimized the flickering effect of lightning in tutorial levels.
- Optimized the unlock prompt for the Alter, making it more obvious.
- Optimized the card description for [Forest Rat].
- Optimized the tutorial guide for water consumption in the tutorial levels.

- Adjusted the King Rat's health capacity from infinite to 200.
- Adjusted the card distribution rules: some cards now require unlocking outside the run before appearing in the random pool.
- Adjusted the water restoration effect of the [Fountain] card: now, [Fountain] cards drawn from the deck restore 20 water points only after being connected, instead of restoring immediately upon appearing.

- Added feedback in the ritual house in the forest when the connection sequence is incorrect.
- Added additional story content related to the [Owl].

[h2]BUG Feedback Channels[/h2]

You can provide feedback through the bug feedback button in the game's settings menu.  
You're also welcomed to join our Discord.

notes.title: Roots Devour Demo Now Available!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, we are Rewinding Games, and our indie game "Roots Devour" is now available for free on Steam!

"Roots Devour" is a Lovecraftian-themed indie game where you play as a newborn ancient god, traversing a silent and eerie forest in search of offerings to connect with and consume.
The game combines strategy card mechanics with simulation elements. You'll explore the unknown forest, extend your roots, absorb blood and resources, build your deck, and use strategic planning to overcome challenges and uncover hidden truths.

The demo features the first chapter of the game, including the [b]Deep Forest[/b], the first map, and [b]The Alter[/b], the skill system. Estimated playtime ranges from 40 to 150 minutes, with certain elements offering replayability.

The full version is currently in development, and the content presented in the demo does not represent the final quality of the game. If you encounter any issues or have any feedback, please use the [b]"Feedback"[/b] and [b]"Bug Report"[/b] options in the main menu to share your valuable insights with us!
Join our discord channel to stay updated and connect with us!

Join our [url=https://discord.gg/mEUkzz6qKQ]Discord[/url] for more information.
